scope: Synthetic architecture semantics only; no production API, Room, backup, SDK, device, or performance verification.
clockBoundary: SYNTHETIC_COMPARABLE_ONLY is a fixture assumption; it cannot grant comparability or effective focus to real wrist records.

cases.description: Same session ID on phone and wrist remains distinct.
Installation and delimiter-containing IDs cannot collide.
Two overlapping ten-unit intervals yield fifteen, not twenty.
Adjacent intervals merge; a contained interval adds no duration.
Reference intervals are clipped to the requested half-open window.
Duplicate source identity and content is counted once.
Same source identity with different content rejects the total.
Complete reading/rest timelines retain rest facts but exclude rest duration.
Wall clock-only input cannot generate a dual-device total.
Missing endpoint, rollback, and excessive single-interval jump reject totals.
Gaps, overlapping segments, and unknown kinds are not silently skipped.
Unsafe integer boundaries and invalid windows reject calculations.
A calculable subset cannot masquerade as a complete total.
Synthetic reference remains reference even when uncertain wall time is calculable.
FULL is not calibration; PARTIAL does not invalidate a separately qualified reference interval.
Phone non-reading classifications remain excluded from the new reference model.
50+1 lookahead detects an additional member and traverses it once.
Source and installation tie-breakers remain deterministic across a page boundary.
Unknown end time stays unknown and receivedAt cannot determine completion order.
A late historical import appears only in a new fixed-membership view.
A cursor from before source retirement or restore cannot continue a new view.
An active phone record ending later does not silently alter existing membership.
An absent end page does not invent progress or write updatedAt.
Equal or lower valid end pages never regress or write updatedAt.
A valid advance writes once; repeating the same raw record has no side effect.
Any active workflow, including another book and PENDING closeout, defers progress.
Missing or mismatched stable book ID defers without mutating raw facts.
Invalid current ranges, backward end pages, and non-IN_PROGRESS statuses defer.
After an older backup restore, admission is recalculated from current book and workflow.
Synthetic serialized guarded transactions preserve maximum progress in either order.
A complete closed zero-length interval contributes zero while an unknown endpoint rejects the total.
A nullable or missing start page prevents progress admission without changing raw facts.
Unknown, non-positive, fractional, or unsafe current total pages cannot authorize an advance.
